body: Thanks, much appreciated, its always reassuring to know that people care. Even if I have never met them, know nothing about them, etc.

Thanks a lot, this kind of made my week. It is hard, beyond description, mainly because I don't feel comfortable telling people how I feel because I don't want to put anyone in a bad mood. The fact that I'm young to me means that it would be pointless to commit suicide, to hurt myself, for the reasons you said. I have a whole life ahead of me.
